scenes.narration: How do NBA players really get paid? It's not a fixed amount.
The league's labor deal ties a salary cap to basketball-related income. In 2011-12, players' share was 51.2 percent.
When revenue grows, the cap grows. In 1984-85, teams could pay 4.6 million dollars total. In 2025-26, the cap is 154.6 million.
Teams must also spend at least 90 percent of the cap on players.
